questions.q: What is the agreed load-time target for last_7 / last_15 / last_30 on a high-volume org (e.g. p95 < 2s wall clock for recentHits+hits)?
questions.answer: Tiered cold-cache p95 for recentHits+hits combined: today/last_7 < 1s; last_15 < 2s; last_30 < 3s. Warm/cached < 300ms any range. Loading indicator must appear on any non-instant range switch. | Adjusted after measure: last_7 cold <2s (was 1s); warm via app Cache.
